name: waynestate/booster
description: WELD's upgrade tool: plans and runs PHP and Laravel upgrade hops on top of Rector, using CREED's version policy.

suggest.phpcompatibility/php-compatibility: Optional: enables the PHP compatibility advisory scan (booster plan, booster scan). Install with composer require --dev phpcompatibility/php-compatibility:"^10.0@alpha"
suggest.squizlabs/php_codesniffer: Optional: the PHP_CodeSniffer runner the PHP compatibility scan needs.

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run every CI check: manifest, tests, style, static analysis, audit, hop data freshness, agent-ready files
scripts-descriptions.creed-copy:check: Verify src/Creed still matches a fresh export from the CREED checkout in $CREED_PATH
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
